noeuds.role: Green node (value): gives a random number between "From" and "To", drawn again each time it is used. Connect it to a setting with the 🔗 button of the settings window.
noeuds.exemple: make a coin appear at a random X between 0 and 800.

noeuds.role: Green node (value): gives a value of the chosen object during the game: its x or y position, width, rotation, opacity…
noeuds.exemple: put a coin at the same height as the player (Y ← object value: player, y).

noeuds.role: Green node (value): gives the current value of a variable (score, lives…) during the game.
noeuds.exemple: show the score in a text (Text ← variable value: score).

noeuds.schema: Inputs: A, Operation, B  →  Output: none (end of script)
noeuds.role: Green node (value): calculates A + B, A − B, A × B or A ÷ B. A and B can be numbers, or receive a green wire themselves (chained calculations).
noeuds.exemple: give twice as many points (Value ← calculation: score × 2).

noeuds.role: Green node (value): gives the column of the cell the finger touches (0 = the first on the left). Plug it into a setting with the 🔗 button.
noeuds.exemple: know which column was touched to place a tower.

noeuds.role: Green node (value): gives the row of the cell the finger touches (0 = the first at the top). Plug it into a setting with the 🔗 button.
noeuds.exemple: know which row was touched to place a building.

noeuds.role: Green node (value): gives the column of the cell where the chosen object is (0 = the first on the left).
noeuds.exemple: know in which column the hero is.

noeuds.role: Green node (value): gives the row of the cell where the chosen object is (0 = the first at the top).
noeuds.exemple: know in which row the hero is.

noeuds.role: Green node: the current turn number (1, 2, 3…), plug it in with the 🔗 button.

noeuds.nom: Steps to reach the touched cell
noeuds.role: Green node: the number of steps to reach the touched cell (-1 if it is outside the zone). Handy to count remaining steps.
noeuds.exemple: remaining steps = the unit's steps - this number.

noeuds.role: Green node: the name of the terrain of the touched cell ("Forest", "Water"…), or nothing if there is none. Terrains are set in the tile editor.
noeuds.exemple: show "Forest" when a forest cell is touched.

noeuds.nom: Terrain cost of the touched cell
noeuds.role: Green node: the step cost of the terrain of the touched cell (1 if there is none).
noeuds.exemple: say "this costs 2 steps" before a move.

noeuds.role: Green node: the name of the terrain the chosen object stands on.
noeuds.exemple: know whether the hero is in water or on the road.

noeuds.role: Green node: the defense bonus of the terrain under the chosen object.

noeuds.schema: Inputs: Object A, Object B  →  Output: none (end of script)
noeuds.role: Green node (value): gives the distance (in pixels) between the centers of two objects during the game.
noeuds.exemple: shake the screen harder when the enemy is close.
